environment: single isolated task environment recommended: adapters and hosted callback run in-process
requirements: Python3.13 chosen to meet MCP-Sec>=3.13 and Cisco Skill<3.15
Cisco Skill source build requiresGo1.27.1+ and locked native CEL helper; dynamic installed VCS version must be measured
Record actual dependency resolution, native package/file/helper hashes before freeze; source commit pins do not pin every transitive version
Any added Fugu runtime dependencies must be lead-selected/frozen in the same isolated environment; source import uses accepted engine snapshot
MCP-Sec analysis package must resolve from pinned source root/detection; native packaging needs verification, no target-server lab submodule needed
Compiler/build failure is an unresolved prerequisite, no older/unverified tool substitution
Per-lane SDK clients have max_retries=0 and native timeout Skill120/MCP30; no unobserved LiteLLM client dispatches. Check installed dispatch seam and native parameters before data release.

Freeze clean native launcher environment; resolve no ambient policy/taxonomy/provider override. Skill reasoning/force-JSON overrides are unset unless declared. Record installed native effective policy and source path hashes before data release.
MCP-Sec native detection0.1.0 wheel lacks detection.core/subpackages. Exact unchanged pinned source-tree PYTHONPATH must be independently verified/disclosed; do not claim wheel success.

native_interfaces.cisco-mcp: StaticAnalyzer([YaraAnalyzer(), LLMAnalyzer(Config(openai/Ultra,1000,retries3,30s,temp0.1))]).scan_tools_file(original tools.json); equivalent CLI global --analyzers yara,llm --format raw static --tools
native_interfaces.sentinel: native scan_mcp_manifest(original tools wrapper), equivalent sentinel-scan mcp --manifest tools.json --output raw.json --fail-on high
native_interfaces.mcp-sec-audit: native run_static_pipeline with original name/description mapped only to tool_name/tool_content; inputSchema ignored by native interface

configuration_differences.model: existing Nebius Ultra replaces upstream model defaults through documented OpenAI-compatible route; this is not a default-provider benchmark
configuration_differences.SDK: direct SDK zero-retry observed transport replaces LiteLLM dispatch; original exceptions/response schema/reasoning options preserved, native retry loops unchanged; unsupported extra options fail before dispatch
configuration_differences.behavioral: local native dataflow; optional LLM alignment not enabled, as native default

observability: One persisted NativeRequestCounter(limit1800) across both Cisco lanes, separate from Fugu journals. Every actual SDK dispatch/fallback/retry counted before network; full request and options hashes keyed run/context/stage/ordinal/global number. Raw responses private; safe usage/errors/nulls retained. Quota/auth/cap/orphan/evidence stops persist.
